    AI Overview
    Several major class action lawsuits against Google have reached settlements or are ongoing, focusing on data privacy, antitrust, and consumer protection. Notable 2026 cases include a
    $700M Play Store antitrust settlement, a $135M Android cellular data collection settlement, and a $68M voice assistant recording suit. Users should check specialized websites to file claims. 
    Key Google Class Action Lawsuits and Settlements: 
    • Google Play Store Antitrust ($700 Million): A settlement was reached over claims that Google monopolized app distribution and in-app billing, causing higher prices for consumers.
    • Android Data Collection ($135 Million)
      :
      This lawsuit alleges Android devices sent data to Google over cellular networks even when idle, resulting in a $135 million settlement. The deadline to file a claim is May 9, 2026.
    • Google Assistant Privacy ($68 Million): Google agreed to pay $68 million to settle claims that it illegally recorded private conversations via its voice assistant.
    • Incognito Mode Privacy (Pending): A lawsuit alleging tracking in Chrome's "Incognito" mode was tentatively settled.
    • Advertiser Monopoly ($100 Million): A potential settlement regarding overpayments in the AdWords program. 
    How to Find and Join Lawsuits:
    Many class action settlements have dedicated websites. Examples include: 
    • Google Play State AG Antitrust Litigation
    • Cellular Data Class Action
    • Google Assistant Privacy Class Action
    • Top Class Actions often lists available claims.

    People also ask
    How do I claim my Google settlement?
    An AI Overview is not available for this searchCan't generate an AI overview right now. Try again later.
    AI Overview
    For the $700M Google Play Store settlement, most eligible users (those who made purchases between August 2016 and September 2023) do
    not need to file a claim. Payments are automatic via PayPal or Venmo. To update contact info or check eligibility, visit the official site: GooglePlayStateAGAntitrustLitigation.com. 
    How to Receive Payment (Google Play Antitrust Settlement): 
    • Automatic Payment: Eligible customers will automatically receive an email (PayPal) or text (Venmo) about their payment after final approval.
    • Opt-In for Updates: If you want to ensure your information is current, check this site.
    • Deadline for Exclusion/Objection:
      If you wish to exclude yourself to sue separately, you must submit this by February 19, 2026.
    • Final Hearing: The court will hold a hearing on April 30, 2026, to approve the settlement. 
    Important Details: 
    • Amount: The payment amount varies based on your purchase history, with a guaranteed minimum amount of at least $2.
    • Who is covered: People who made purchases on the Google Play Store between August 2016 and September 2023.
    • Scams: Be aware that the payment will come from the Settlement Administrator, not via random text links. Ensure you are visiting the official website. 
    Note: There are other separate lawsuits against Google; ensure you are looking for the "Google Play State AG Antitrust Litigation" for this $700m deal.
